evidence: Late on April 25, Bitcoin staged an intraday recovery from a 6-week low near $38,200 back to around $40,100, partially aided by market sentiment surrounding Elon Musk's finalized agreement to buy Twitter. However, market commentary emphasizes that $40,000 has turned into stiff technical resistance, with macro risk-off sentiment and weakening global economic conditions continuing to exert downward pressure on risk assets. Because the price rebound faces immediate technical resistance while broader macro headwinds persist, the odds of a positive 24-hour return from midnight UTC are assessed as slightly below even.
limitations: General macro and longer-term structural items (e.g., Central African Republic legal tender adoption, MicroStrategy shareholder reports, Bitcoin Core 23.0 release) were discounted as direct short-term price drivers.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
